Our men are on site to facilitate traffic  flow. 

#FollowLASTMA

[4:48PM] #OkotaIsolo #TrafficUpdate 

The stretch of road from Cele towards Pako is experiencing free-flowing traffic, with similar conditions observed on the return journey. Ago Palace Road, in both inward and outward directions from Apple Junction, is also clear. Motorists can expect smooth transit on Nwachukwu Drive connecting to Cele, and its return route.

Furthermore, the Cele Link Bridge, both inward towards Ijesha and for the return journey, is clear of congestion. Within the inner parts of Ire Akari to Osolo Road, traffic is moving freely in both directions. On Ibeh Road Apata, the inward journey from Transformer Junction to Ilasa Underbridge service lane is also experiencing good flow, mirroring conditions on the return route.

Similarly, the stretch of Oke Afa towards Lasutech Roundabout is clear, with unhindered movement in both directions. Daleko Bridge, specifically the inward journey towards Palm Avenue Junction, is currently free of congestion. Finally, the area around Five Star, encompassing the stretch towards Ijesha Express on both the main carriageways and service lanes, is reported to be clear with no impediments at this time.

#FollowLASTMA
